description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Create a mailbox (e.g. hello@mycoffeeshop.com) on a domain that has GearHost email turned on (enable_email). A strong password is generated and returned once: give it to the user and suggest they change it after signing in to webmail. If each mailbox costs extra on the site's plan, the first call changes nothing and returns needs_confirmation with the monthly charge; call again with accept_charges:true ONLY after the user agrees. Returns structuredContent { status, address, password, webmail, settings:{ incoming, outgoing } }.

accept_charges.description: Set true only after the user agreed to the monthly charge a previous call returned.

username.description: The part before the @, e.g. "hello" for hello@mycoffeeshop.com. Letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores.

name: create_mailbox

password.description: Shown once. A credential: give it only to the user.

title: Create a mailbox
